newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor trade closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor trade closed for holiday.

text.p: There was no castor trading in India on Wednesday in view of a national holiday, dealers said.
Castorseed December prices were steady on Tuesday in narrow trade although sentiment was subdued, dealers said.

Sentiment was subdued in the absence of fresh export demand and following reports of new crop arrivals in southern states. Groundnut oil fell to 400 rupees per 10 kg from 404/405 rupees. In Rajkot spot oil fell to 570/575 rupees per 15 kg from 590/595 rupees. "Daily new crop arrivals of groundnut seed in Gujarat region in (western India rose to 100,000 bags," a miller said.
